title: Kid Punch taking him to the Lyric Cabaret
summary: His homeboy Kid Punch took him to the Lyric Cabaret and introduced him as his clarinet player before he could play.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Kid Punching them? No, I never saw them down there. I used to see Willie Irmfree, I used to see them at the Larrick Cabaret. I used to go to the Larrick Cabaret. They had the old Larrick Theater down in the street. They used to have what you call Larrick Cabaret. They had a cabaret down below underneath the theater. They had a nightclub called Cabaret. I remember Willie Irmfree, Punch taking me there. The first time I went there, Punch taking me there. He was my homeboy quite nice. He used to take me around and when we'd go in places like that, he'd say, well this is my clarinet player. I didn't even know how to play at that time, but he would just tell the people that they'd get me in. They didn't know what they knew him. So anyway, we went to see Willie Irmfree. I remember that a long time ago.
